name: Configuration Drift Monitoring
description: Continuously monitors agent, tool, and MCP server configurations for drift from established baselines. Detects unauthorized changes, misconfigurations, and security degradation over time.
threat_addressed: Tool descriptions, MCP server configurations, and policy files can be modified after approval. Without continuous drift monitoring, post-approval changes go undetected — enabling semantic supply chain attacks.
enforcement_mechanism: Tool description hashes checked against audited baselines per invocation or per session (configurable TTL). Configuration files monitored for unauthorized changes. Drift triggers alerts and re-approval workflows.

security_outcome.pass: Monitoring covers all registered tools. Hash comparison continuous or per-session. Alerts within defined window.
security_outcome.fail: Configuration drift detected — current state differs from baseline.

display_detail: Monitors agent and tool configurations for drift from established security baselines.
remediation_hint_template: Configuration drift detected. Compare current configuration against baseline and authorize or revert changes.
